messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up: Scarab dedicated bring-up scheduled tomorrow 09:30 PT. We need final quota, autoscale params, loadtest window, and KMS rotation time. @sam_engineering @priya_sre

sam_engineering: Quota confirmed: 50k tokens/min across 3 reserved slots. Start with 3 workers; burst cap = 6. Billing tag: acct=scarab-dedicated-2026. Pushing infra PR with configs today.

priya_sre: SRE recs: min_replicas=2, autoscale cpu_target=60%, token_rate_window=30s, scale_cooldown=90s. Plan a 20m shadow canary before shifting traffic. KMS rotate at 10:45 PT (if green).

maria_cs: Customer also wants documented fallback when primary pool saturates. Proposed fallback -> gpt-neox-20b-quant. @eli_cloud_ops can you validate routing/perf delta?

eli_cloud_ops: Confirmed routing ok. Fallback adds ~300-400ms median latency. Added rule scarab-prod -> scarab-fallback priority 0 and noted perf in runbook.

sam_engineering: Added warmup hooks in infra PR. Warmup schedule T-15 and T-5 before traffic shift. Example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/warmup -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY' -d '{"model":"scarab-primary","prefixes":["Hi","Order status","/api/lookup"]}'
```

ops_bot: Reservation: loadtest-scarab-285000 (10:00-11:30 UTC). Pool lock applied. Incident channel reserved: #eng-oncall.

release_ops: Acknowledged. No serving fleet deploys between 09:00-12:00 PT. Posting waiver for visibility.

jordan_re: Shared onboarding bundle to Scarab PM (link: https://docs.internal/redwood/scarab-onboard). They requested a 30m walkthrough ~+30m after canary completes.

maria_cs: Runbook timeline: 09:30 sync, 09:40 warmup, 09:50 shadow canary (20m), 10:15 ramp to 50% (obs check), 10:30 full loadtest, 10:45 KMS rotate (if green), 11:15 postmortem. Blockers?

priya_sre: One ask: wire P95 and tail error counts for 48h into console dashboards and daily CSV export to CS.

eli_cloud_ops: Done. Dashboard Scarab > Health > Latency & Errors created; daily CSV export set to cs-alerts@redwood.ai.

maria_cs: Excellent. I'll send the customer prep email EOD. Closing unless new issues. :white_check_mark:
